system.description: Spend three Blood Traits to assume a horrific bat-human hybrid form, gaining all benefits of Horrid Form plus flight up to 25 mph (not increased by Celerity), able to carry up to your own body weight aloft. Bony wing-claws function as Feral Claws. You are down two Traits on hearing-based perception but gain one bonus Trait on vision-based wits/perception challenges.
